The file sandboxie-defaults-5.73.8.json reproduces the 15 effective setting
names and 100 values selected by the stock [DefaultTemplates] list. ExitGuard
converted that subset to JSON, removed template headings/comments/metadata,
and uses it as an exact-match compatibility baseline. The actual setting
strings were not modified. The modified data source is included in this
package; the repository copy is internal/nativeapp/data/.

Sandboxie core source/data are licensed under GNU GPL version 3 (source
headers permit version 3 or later). The applicable full license is provided
in GPL-3.0.txt. The data and this preview are provided without warranty.

No Sandboxie driver, DLL, service, installer, SandMan UI, support certificate,
or other vendor binary is included. The separately installed official
Sandboxie Plus runtime has its own applicable licensing terms. ExitGuard
uses its exported documented API and Start.exe entry point at runtime.
